description: REQUIRES prior hometax__session__login call with same account_link_id. Issue an e-tax invoice to 국세청. IRREVERSIBLE: once issued the buyer is notified and it enters VAT filing; it can only be corrected by issuing a 수정세금계산서, and this service's modify tool only issues one that cancels the original in full (reasons 04 and 06). Call without confirm first — you get a preview of the main values you sent (the supply amount and tax are computed by the server and are not in it); show it to the user, get their approval, then retry with confirm=true. Never set confirm=true on your own. 호출마다 토큰 1소진 요청 처리 시 XBOSS 작업을 생성하고 처리 결과를 저장합니다. 기관 원본의 조회 여부와 별개로 이 호출은 순수 읽기 전용이 아닙니다. 기관 데이터 변경은 도구별 실행 내용과 기존 확인 절차를 따릅니다.

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

confirm.description: Set true ONLY after showing the preview to the user and receiving their explicit approval. Omit it on the first call to obtain the preview.

dmnr_bsno.description: Buyer business registration number (구매자 사업자등록번호, 10 digits)

etxiv_clsf_cd.description: Invoice class code (전자세금계산서 구분코드). Optional. The tax is 10% of the supply amount whatever this code is.

etxiv_knd_cd.description: Invoice kind code (전자세금계산서 종류코드). Optional. The tax is 10% of the supply amount whatever this code is.

name: hometax__etax__invoice__issue
title: 전자세금계산서 발행
